children: MEXICO CITY--Mexican industrial production got off to a strong start in the third quarter with gains in construction and manufacturing output offsetting weakness in mining.
In July, industrial output rose 0.5% from June in seasonally adjusted terms, national statistics institute Inegi said Friday.
Manufacturing output increased 0.7%, with gains in production of vehicles and auto parts and in computers and electronic equipment. Construction activity rose 0.9%.
Mining output fell 1.8% from June, with both oil and gas production and mineral extraction falling 0.3%, while mining services were down 15%.
Industrial production rose 2.7% unadjusted from July of 2025, was up 0.4% in the first seven months of the year.
